questions.topic: Weighted shrinking along a flex line
questions.stem: What does flex: 0 1 200px set for an item?

options.text: Grow 1, shrink 0, and basis 200px.
No grow, shrink allowed, and a 200px basis.
Grow 0, shrink 0, and basis 200px.
Grow 1, shrink 1, and basis 0.

questions.explanation: flex: 0 1 200px means grow 0, shrink 1, basis 200px. Swapped or zeroed readings are wrong.

questions.topic: Distributing free space with space-between
questions.stem: A dispatcher wants logo left and nav right with no extra edge gaps. Which value?

options.text: center, because it pushes items to edges.
space-around, because it removes outer gaps.
space-between, because it places extremes at edges.
flex-end, because it splits items across edges.

questions.explanation: space-between places first and last at edges. The other values cluster or misplace items.

questions.topic: Counting the elements a descendant selector reaches
questions.stem: A dispatcher writes a[href] and expects only direct links in nav. Why too broad?

options.text: It matches only the first link in each container.
Attribute selectors only match direct children automatically.
It matches no elements because nav is missing.
The attribute selector matches every a with href anywhere in the document, not only in nav.

questions.explanation: a[href] matches all such links document-wide. Scoping requires nav in the selector.

questions.topic: Choosing the winning declaration among three rules
questions.stem: Explain how cascade layers let a dispatcher control which of three style groups wins.

answer.exemplar: Cascade layers declare an explicit order, so a later layer's declarations win regardless of specificity within earlier layers.

questions.explanation: Layer order overrides specificity within layers. The tempting specificity-only idea is wrong.

questions.topic: Counting list items when an end tag is missing
questions.stem: A dispatcher wants cleaner markup. Which end tag may be safely omitted before a block element?

options.text: div, because div end tags are always optional.
p, because a following block element auto-closes it.
span, because inline end tags are optional.
None, because omitting any end tag is invalid.

questions.explanation: p end tags may be omitted before block elements. div and span do not share this optionality.
questions.hint: p end tag may be omitted.

questions.topic: Margins that stop collapsing inside a flex container
questions.stem: In a flex row, two items each have 10px horizontal margins. What is the gap between them?

options.text: 0px, because flex ignores margins.
10px, because horizontal margins collapse in flex.
20px, because margins do not collapse and add together.
40px, because margins double in rows.

questions.explanation: Flex margins do not collapse, so 10 plus 10 gives 20. Collapse or doubling ideas are wrong.

questions.topic: A fixed track beside a fractional one
questions.learningObjective: Use repeat with fixed and fr
questions.stem: Which definition creates a 200px sidebar plus three equal flexible columns?

options.text: 200px auto auto auto, fixing only the first loosely.
repeat(4, 1fr), giving four equal columns including sidebar.
200px 1fr 1fr 1fr is invalid syntax.
200px repeat(3, 1fr), with the sidebar fixed and the rest flexible.

questions.explanation: 200px repeat(3, 1fr) fixes the sidebar and flexes the rest. Equal columns or auto lose the fixed sidebar.

questions.topic: Weighted shrinking along a flex line
questions.stem: A dispatcher sets flex-shrink 2 but items still shrink equally. Why?

options.text: flex-shrink 2 is invalid and defaults to 1.
Equal flex-basis values make shrink weights produce equal amounts.
Shrink only works when grow is also set.
The browser ignores shrink above 1.

questions.explanation: Shrink amounts depend on basis sizes too; equal bases can yield equal shrink. The other options misstate validity or limits.

questions.topic: Distributing free space with space-between
questions.stem: Explain why space-between can look wrong with a single item.

answer.exemplar: With one item, space-between has no space to distribute between items, so the item sits at the start edge.

questions.explanation: space-between needs at least two items to create gaps. A single item sits at the start.
questions.hint: One item sits at the start.

questions.topic: Counting the elements a descendant selector reaches
questions.stem: A dispatcher wants to style links only inside a footer. Which selector?

options.text: footer > a, because descendant requires direct children only.
a footer, because descendant order can be reversed.
footer a, because it scopes to descendants of footer.
.footer a, which only works with a class, not an element.

questions.explanation: footer a scopes to descendants of footer. Reversed or class-only ideas are wrong.
